positive_d3_rule: iterative mean D2 hits is at least 10 percent above both baselines and both paired 95 percent bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero on the positive side
negative_d3_rule: for at least one required baseline, the upper bound of the paired 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval is below the 10 percent minimum meaningful advantage expressed in D2 hits
scope_limit: D3 applies only to repeated strategy behavior inside this fixed seven-record MP MoS2 environment; it is not a general materials-discovery claim
